decisions.reason: Senior living counseling costs little to keep, fits growing demographic demand and was featured prominently, so the option still holds clear upside and should stay open.

The retail shop carries fixed running costs and gets only a modest mention, but it still supports workshop sales and the sheltered-employment mission, and its value is not yet resolved, so it stays open for one more year under review.
Meal delivery for seniors was launched only in 2024, sits close to the core eldercare offer and has uncertain but plausible demand, so keeping this cheap option open to learn more is justified.
